label: Diagram 2.6
caption: Diagram 2.6 | Examples of WC/cloakroom layouts
description: The drawing, titled Diagram 2.6 Examples of WC/cloakroom layouts, shows two floor plans of small rooms, each with a door opening outwards and swing arcs, plus a Notes column at the right. Example 2.6A is a plan with an overall top dimension of 1450mm, divided into 450mm and 1000mm, a left dimension of 1800mm and a right dimension of 1000mm. It contains a toilet at the top, a basin on the left wall marked 350mm, a door at the bottom right marked 750mm, a point in the top right corner with dashed lines, and a shaded access area. Example 2.6B is a plan with an overall top dimension of 1450mm, divided into 1000mm and 450mm, a left dimension of 1800mm with an inner dimension of 1000mm. It contains a basin at the top left, a toilet at the top right marked 450mm, a door at the bottom right, a point in the top left corner with dashed lines, and a shaded access area. The Notes read: 1. Dimensions for illustration purposes only. 2. Doors should open outwards. 3. Stack and drainage positions to be shown clear of access zones where located within WC / Cloakroom.
